name: etf-update

name: repo-maintenance
prompt: Use the repo-maintenance subagent to run a weekly maintenance sweep of my GitHub repos: wicek, homelab, charts, discord-bot, homeassistant, renovate-config (all under github.com/xxczaki). For each repo, find red Renovate/release CI runs and failing automated PRs, diagnose them, and fix only the safe cases on a branch via a PR (gh pr create). Never merge, never force-push, never push to main directly. Work through the repos one at a time to stay within the Raspberry Pi's resources. End with a one-line status per repo and links to any PRs you opened; if everything is already green, say so.

name: weekly-maintenance
prompt:
Weekly maintenance. Work through each step, then reply with one short summary (a few bullets, under 800 characters).

1. Memory – reconcile ~/.claude/projects/-app/memory. Read MEMORY.md and every file. Merge duplicates. Rewrite any file that contradicts itself so it states only the newest evidence. Delete wrong or stale facts – when unsure, check transcripts from the last 30 days (~/.claude/projects/-app/*.jsonl), and drop time-sensitive facts (prices, holdings, versions) that you can't confirm. Fix or remove [[links]] to memories that don't exist. Make MEMORY.md exactly one line per existing file.
2. Layout – follow the Data Locations convention in CLAUDE.md. Move git clones in the /data root into /data/repos/ (skip any with uncommitted changes and mention them). Move other loose files and directories in the /data root into /data/tmp/. Never move .pnpm-store, repos, tmp, outbox, media, attachments, sessions.json, or lost+found.
3. Cleanup – `find /data/tmp /data/outbox /data/media /data/attachments -mindepth 1 -mtime +7 -delete` (ignore missing directories), then remove empty directories left behind.
4. pnpm store – `pnpm store prune --store-dir /data/.pnpm-store`.

Report memory changes, files moved, and disk space reclaimed (`du -sh /data` before and after).
